environment.description: Kafka consumer running on EKS with default service account. Kafka topic 'user-updates' is writable by any authenticated producer in the cluster. No schema registry enforcement. No field-level ACLs on the consumer. HSM is a SoftHSM2 instance running as a sidecar with PKCS#11 interface exposed via Unix socket. The consumer pod has network access to the HSM sidecar and the Kafka brokers without additional policy restrictions.
